Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 18 July 2003, the matter described above is not lawful within the meaning of section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
	
The volume of proposed conservatory at 2.5 m in height, 4m in width and 3m in depth, when added to the rear extension and garage which are within 5m of the dwelling (as extended), would exceed 70 cubic metres.  

	The development, therefore, fails to qualify as Class A permitted development within Part 1 of Schedule 2 of The Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995, and requires planning permission.
